# High Roller Technologies to Present at the Sidoti Small-Cap Virtual Conference


September 04, 2026 3:00 pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_0039acdfb8deaf52aa9686f6b618a7b6/highroller/news/2026-09-04_High_Roller_Technologies_to_Present_at_the_Sidoti__164.pdf)


**LAS VEGAS, Nevada, Sept. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --** High Roller Technologies, Inc. ("High Roller" or the "Company") (NYSE: ROLR), a publicly traded online gaming and prediction markets company, today announced that members of its management team will present at the Sidoti Small-Cap Virtual Conference, September 23–24, 2026.


Management will deliver company presentations and be available for one-on-one meetings with registered investors during the conference.


**Conference Details**
**Dates:** September 23–24, 2026
**Format:** Virtual
**Company Presentation:** September 24, 2026
**Time:** 12:15 PM ET
**Webcast:**[Webinar Registration](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=zuYNB9eIL-AXC4dIl9Fd_aKrSfmARuk9PcWkbyON7OE0VKZVs_x5bBqQafdQSerzZYpiBq4HLMQONpVsN0_qp7U5kosME4QmpHX0XV_6TKPvqGTpg-ssyGCGqcOlvdVZLxn11t6KtkqqlqNA9F78Aev10LJoToPMYnt5zULlnZY=)
**Conference Registration:**[Full conference registration](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=O8nAKzrQklOyjbBoEyjJ_ngdApyNwywhadRRXeA-oe3U_kqNK99m-BIUMiTuZ5il9aGD0MI33e_U04o9UcAtvNXp8aPz0h4B5WZAS_APxX3bUYfBTPKRfcy3xa_sxU-i13OwbUezg5RMUabWi-cLdlU9ER41xGcIwl801U61e5xy8L56BgxBd8iMqr-iNZa2GS-Ltpzlon0rM1DQm-FgbA==)


Investors interested in meeting with High Roller should submit a meeting request through the Sidoti conference platform or contact their Sidoti representative.


A replay of the Sidoti presentation will also be available following the event through the conference platform.
